decisions.reason: After several years the option value is lower, but as a technically related component line that supports the broader drainage family at limited carrying cost, it is still worth keeping.
Floor-level shower drainage remains central to the firm's stated direction, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it without clear evidence of failure.
As the flagship designer drainage line aligned with the firm's future positioning, it is a product the firm would continue to back rather than abandon.
The integrated sloped shower element complements the core shower-drainage system offer for renovation and accessible-bathroom projects, so it remains a useful option to retain.
Although it is more niche and less central than the shower-focused lines, its clear problem-solving use case in drainage and likely manageable support cost make retention more likely than withdrawal.
